methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This work presents an analytical hierarchy process (AHP) to rank alternatives on energy saving opportunities

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Presents an Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP / MCDM) decision-support method (via Expert Choice) to rank six energy-saving alternatives from an energy audit report. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised: energy consumption/elasticity/intensity appear only as AHP decision sub-criteria (defined at a macroeconomic energy-per-GDP level), not as models with variables, functional form, or a construction/estimation approach. Tool/framework without EnPI/EnB content.

paper_type.evidence_quote: an energy audit report undertaken on an onshore and offshore oil and gas operation in Java Sea

stage1.notes: AHP/MCDM ranking of energy-saving options for an Indonesian upstream oil & gas operation (onshore/offshore extraction, not refining). Ineligible: no EnPI/EnB model. level_3b forced not applicable per ineligibility rule.
